name: kernel-arch-rv64
description: RISC-V 64 implementation of witos/arch.h and witos/virtual.h (plan steps V1.2, V1.3 and V1.4): identity, guarded boot stack, the interrupt flag and halting, the trap vector with full register frames, the timer-interrupt scheduler hook, Sv48 kernel translation tables, U-mode thread frames, contexts and entry, user translation tables, code publication, the SBI call, the boot hart's identity, the secondary harts through SBI HSM with their inter-processor interrupts, and the compiler helpers.
